limitations: Static supplied-artifact facts; no original-game execution.
Trainer ground following is physics-based inference; original geometry/physics retained for runtime verification.
Pool implementation must reset private timers/flags and release station ownership; original destroys objects and reinitializes via Start.

No target population clamp beyond initial three and leave/replacement timers; bounded three-slot pooling is a reconstruction adaptation requiring source timing preservation, not a native serialized pool size.
